itemdesc-clothes-head-easterlingshemagh: The people of Rhun have always covered their bodies
itemdesc-armor-body-easterling-lokegamp: Quite literally the bite of the Emperor's army, the Loke-Gamp Rim are highly trained pikemen and swordsmen of the Loke-Rim.
itemdesc-armor-body-easterling-lokeflag: Heavily armoured and armed, the Loke-Flag Rim are capable shock troops, usually wielding heavy steel maces or axes and protect themselves with large shields.
itemdesc-armor-body-easterling-lokenar: The Loke-Nar Rim are some of the finest scouts in Middle-earth. They usually utilize large composite longbows with incredible range and power.
itemdesc-armor-head-easterling-lokegamp: Their job in battle is to close with the enemy under the protection of the Loke-Nar and pin them in position, making the enemy susceptible to envelopment and destruction.
itemdesc-armor-head-easterling-lokeflag: Primarily, their role is to protect the flanks of the Loke-Gamp, but they can also be used to soften the enemy up prior to main battle line engaging in melee.
itemdesc-armor-head-easterling-lokenar: As part of the Emperor's combined arms strategy, they provide the missile screen required for the advance of the infantry and will ensure the expansion of the Golden Empire.
itemdesc-armor-legs-easterling-lokegamp: The mighty men of the Loke-Gamp are the answer. Woe will befall any foolish who strays amongst their well drilled ranks.
itemdesc-armor-legs-easterling-lokeflag: The Loke-Flag is the most versatile regiment, being capable of storming citadels or fighting on open battle plains. Used correctly they are nearly an unstoppable force.
itemdesc-armor-legs-easterling-lokenar: They are given the lightest weapons and armor for their job, so that they won't be found slowed when the time comes to prove their mastery of deceit.
itemdesc-easterling-schematic: A scroll with the smell of salt and smoke, full of knowledge passed down from generations of the Dragon Cult of the Sea of Rhun.
itemdesc-easterling-rolled-schematic: A scroll with the smell of salt and smoke, full of knowledge passed down from generations of the Dragon Cult of the Sea of Rhun
